audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty is written as TRICKY 7/10 with generic reasoning, and the whole full layer refers to Cassiopeia as 'he/him/his' (winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].t, breakdown.wave).
audit.why: Wrong pronoun on a champion the reader is staring at in the loading screen reads as copy-paste, and it is the clearest symptom that this text was never written for Cassiopeia. The real difficulty driver is that Miasma turns Ahri's defining tool off — grounded, Spirit Rush does not cast at all.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the fields edited, and difficulty grounded on Miasma's grounding rather than 'out-ranging your plan'.
sources: brief.enemyKit W ('Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities')

audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows disagree between layers. phases[0].side='Cassiopeia' vs win[0]='Skill'; phases[3].side='Skill' vs win[3]='Cassiopeia'; phases[4].side='Skill' vs win[4]='Ahri'; phases[5].side='Skill' vs win[5]='Cassiopeia'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia/Ahri/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia, which matches the content layer exactly. The full layer is the outlier on all four rows, so the page renders two answers to 'who wins Level 1' and 'who wins Level 6'.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Skill, phases[3].side -> Cassiopeia, phases[4].side -> Ahri, phases[5].side -> Cassiopeia. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies FACING Cassiopeia — targets with their back turned are merely slowed. wants.you[1] just says 'bait Petrify', and spikes[1] says Spirit Rush lets you 'dodge' it.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.' For a champion whose ultimate is three dashes, dashing THROUGH and past her downgrades her 120/100/80-second ultimate to a slow. That is the single most valuable unwritten fact in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.carry and wants.you[1]: flank and keep your back to her, and the stun becomes a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang's healing is never mentioned anywhere in either layer, and no anti-heal timing is given (Itemization only says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — vague and mis-gendered).
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75-second cooldown, 40-mana, 700-range spell that heals her for a percentage of damage dealt and refunds mana on kills. In any extended trade she out-sustains Ahri's passive completely, which is why 1st item and 2+ items both belong to her.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named explicitly and Twin Fang's heal stated in dosFull[2].d, tradeBad and breakdown.trading.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Miasma as matchup-defining but gives no number.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16 seconds — the longest basic-ability cooldown in her kit by a wide margin, and the actual green light for Ahri's forward steps. Noxious Blast is 3.5s and Twin Fang 0.75s, so those are never 'down'.
audit.corrected: '24s at rank 1, and grounded means Spirit Rush simply does not cast. Step up on its downtime.'

audit.why: Serpentine Grace makes every move-speed bonus stronger on her, and Noxious Blast grants move speed when it hits a champion — so she outruns Fox-Fire's 700 range after eating a Q. Worth stating once.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[0].d and tradeGood: orb her while she is still walking out of her own poison, before the speed kicks in.
